message: 憧れへの嫉妬

name: Sally
message: 「Man, Demons really are the worst, aren't they~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look who's talking.」

name: Sally
message: 「It's fine for me because I have a proper goal. Compared to that, that Pasta guy is doing things you couldn't even tell other people about.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't they say that keeping quiet can be a form of kindness, too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft--! Angels really will believe anyone, huh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Without a trusting heart, trust cannot be born.」

name: Sally
message: 「Then, Rolo-chi, are you saying you trust that Pasta guy?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. That and this are two separate matters. It's simply far too broad to lump it all together under the label of 'Demons'」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't give me all that complicated talk.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What I mean is, despite how it may look, I do trust Omake-san at least a little bit.」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh, well I'm flattered.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because I know that Omake-san is a simple person, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「Meaning you can't trust someone you don't really understand.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Put plainly, yes, that's what it comes down to.」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaah--somehow all that talking made me thirsty.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's what happens when you have a serious conversation so out of character.」

name: Ria
message: 「At times like that, here's some tea♪ And some sweets too♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Here. Have some tea too, Synn-kun♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh! Thank you very much.」
Taking a breather while writing down today's activity log.

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is why, you see, people whom you cannot understand tend to be bad news more often than not.」

name: Sally
message: 「You mean Bylous?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just a possibility, mind you?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hm?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could this Bylous person perhaps actually be the Demon Lord?」
W-Well... Normally, that's what anyone would think...

name: Lolotte
message: 「If they're said to be the strongest in the Demon World, that practically guarantees they're the king, doesn't it? That is my deduction--sparkle.」

name: Sally
message: 「Too bad, wrong answer. If he were really the Demon Lord, there's no way he'd go out of his way to be called a Demon General.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm... For an extra, that is an uncharacteristically convincing explanation.」

name: Sally
message: 「If you ask me, the Demon Lord is probably super weak.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So he resorts to scheming cunning plots and using underhanded tricks to trap others, is that it?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah! He's definitely a gloomy, rotten jerk who'd betray anyone at the drop of a hat.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How black-hearted can one be? Pure-hearted as I am, I'll roast my fingernail dirt and feed it to him.」
Whoa, they're really trashing him...
Then again, it'd be weird if I jumped in to deny it.

name: Sally
message: 「Even right now, he's probably busy swindling someone and laughing all the way to the bank.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We can safely conclude he's an unproductive creature who even finds working to be a chore.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not true!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Ria-senpai just roared...?

name: Ria
message: 「The Demon Lord isn't a bad person!! He's actually strong, kind, and dependable...」

name: Ria
message: 「Being a king isn't just about acting all high and mighty!! He cares about everyone and wants to unite the world for everyone's sake!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides... even with this Re-Crea, I'm sure the Demon Lord will do something to save us!!」

name: Ria
message: 「The Seven Demon Generals are nothing compared to him! Even without using underhanded tricks, he can win fair and square!!」

name: Ria
message: 「And yet... the two of you keep saying such awful things about the Demon Lord...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Um... Senpai?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuuh~~. I don't really get it, but I'm sooorry~~\s06」
What on earth happened to Ria-senpai?
I appreciate her covering for me, though...

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Ria-senpai. Calm down a little.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not acting like yourself.」

name: Ria
message: 「Gasp...!! I... oh no!! I just lost control.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm the one who should be sorry. I got all worked up for some reason... geez, stupid Ria.」

name: Ria
message: 「Really... I'm sorry, you two.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You yelled all of a sudden, so you really startled me.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, why did you get so mad anyway? It's not like we were talking bad about you or anything, Ria?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well... that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「We don't know who the Demon Lord is, so isn't it cruel to just jump to conclusions like that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides... wouldn't it be sad if people were talking bad about you behind your back?」
She's trying to keep up appearances as an upperclassman, though it's a bit forced.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's just as Senpai says!!」
She bought it right away, though.

name: Ria
message: 「For example, if Synn-kun turned out to be the Demon Lord or something, that'd be awful, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Wh-What!? Is that true!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uwaaah!! That's way beyond a shocking surprise, there's no time to be taking it easy!!」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no! It was just an example, okay.\s02」
Phew....

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you know. I don't think the Demon Lord is a bad person.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think that because you admire them?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope, it's the opposite. I admire them because the Demon Lord is a really good person.」
I couldn't help wondering why Ria-senpai was sticking up for the Demon Lord so much.

name: Ria
message: 「Whenever Re-Crea draws near, the Demon Lord always appears. If the Demon Lord were a bad person, it wouldn't be surprising if the world had already been destroyed.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yet even so, we're still alive and well like this today. I bet the Demon Lord did something about Re-Crea, don't you think?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed... Unless they were a good person, they wouldn't even think of trying to save the world, would they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. At least, that's what I think. So, this time too, I'm sure... I believe they'll manage to do something about it.」
Just as Senpai says, if the Demon Lord is going to do something about it... then, as expected, I have no choice but to handle it myself.
Still, I wonder what kind of face Ria-senpai would make if she found out that the Demon Lord she admires is actually me.
